highlights.title: Bulk actions fit the row
highlights.detail: The bulk actions show as one button group. The actions that do not fit go into the ⋯ menu.

highlights.title: Selection in the count
highlights.detail: The count reads X/Y selected. Tick the select-all box again to clear the selection.

highlights.title: Cleaner group headers
highlights.detail: Group headers line up with the rows, and the rows have space at the edge again.
